The HVAC filter may be overdue

steps: Remove the filter and check its size and airflow arrow.
Install a matching replacement with the arrow pointing toward the system.
Close the panel and restart the system.
callProIf: Airflow remains weak with a clean filter

Press the test button and confirm the chirping stops.
